g.text: 2021–2022 training | path passage 7–48 h before arrival | future target +6 h

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475563

g.text: Standardized within season × current-PM bins using common strata with ≥10 pass and ≥10 non-pass arrivals; original support stays fixed in resampling.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475563

g.text: Coverage is the fraction of eligible current-observed training arrivals represented by those strata. * <50%: restricted population; NA: no common support.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475563

g.text: Intervals use 500 calendar 7-day block-bootstrap replicates; unstable intervals are omitted. Different rows can represent different populations—do not rank them.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475563

g.text: Residual confounding and within-bin current-PM differences remain. The ≥35 hourly category is for research; these contrasts are not causal transport contributions.
